generationActivity.undoGenerationTooltip: Restore the exercise to the state before the most recent successful generation.
generationActivity.undoAdaptationTooltip: Restore the exercise to the state before the most recent successful adaptation.
generationActivity.undoGenerationConfirmHeader: Undo the most recent successful generation?
generationActivity.undoGenerationConfirmMessage: This restores the problem statement and repositories to their state before generation. You cannot restore the generated version afterward.
generationActivity.undoAdaptationConfirmHeader: Undo the most recent successful adaptation?
generationActivity.undoAdaptationConfirmMessage: This restores the problem statement and repositories to their state before adaptation. You cannot restore the adapted version afterward.
generationActivity.generateConfirmHeader: Generate and automatically save this exercise?
generationActivity.generateConfirmMessage: Hyperion will replace the problem statement, template, solution, and tests after mechanical verification, then save the accepted output automatically. Review every artifact before release. Undo is temporary, stored only in memory, and becomes unavailable after conflicting repository changes or a server restart.
